result.allow.title: Payment sent
result.warn.title: Let's pause for a moment
result.warn.sub: Please answer a few quick questions before you pay.
result.verified.title: Thank you for checking
result.verified.sub: If you are sure, you can continue. You can also cancel.
result.hold.title: Payment paused for your safety
result.hold.sub: Simulated hold — no money has moved.
result.hold.message: Real police, banks and government offices never ask you to pay to stay out of trouble. Hang up the call and talk to someone you trust.
result.cancelled: Payment cancelled. Your money is safe.
q.guiding: Is anyone on the phone telling you to make this payment?
check.under_arrest: The caller said I am under arrest
check.claims_authority: The caller says they are police, CBI, RBI or my bank
check.told_not_to_tell: They told me not to tell anyone or not to hang up
check.asked_to_install_app: They asked me to install an app
alert.title: SMS that would be sent (simulated)
alert.sms: SafePay Shield: {contact}, {name} may be under pressure to make a payment of {range}. The payment is paused. Please call {name} now.
alert.no_contact: No trusted contact has given consent. Add one in Settings.
alert.sent: Alert logged (simulated). No SMS was sent.
why.title: Why?
why.too_little_history: Only {n} past transactions — at least {min} are needed to check this account.
why.model_unavailable: The account check is not available right now.
why.coercion_only_title: Decided on the payment situation alone
why.coercion_only_body: The receiver's account had too little history to check, so the account check could not help. The signals from your phone and this payment were enough on their own.
why.contradictions: Your answers and your phone don't match
why.sources: Model predictions, rule results and simulated demo data are shown separately.
why.empty: Make a payment to see why SafePay Shield decided what it did.
reason.R1: Serious warning signs. For your safety this payment is on a simulated hold.
reason.R2: Several strong signs that someone may be pressuring you to pay.
reason.R3: This account shows suspicious money movement, and there are signs this payment may not be your free choice.
reason.R4: Your answers don't match what your phone shows, and there are signs of pressure.
reason.R5: Some signs that this payment may not be your own free choice. Please check before you pay.
reason.R6: This account shows suspicious money movement.
reason.R6b: This payment is much larger than usual and goes to someone you haven't paid before. Please check the details. This alone is not a sign of a scam.
rule.digital_arrest_pattern: Long video call with an unknown number (digital-arrest pattern)
rule.govt_verification_purpose: Payment for a 'government fine or verification'
rule.authority_claim: Caller claims to be police, CBI, RBI or a bank
rule.unknown_caller_during_payment: On a call with an unknown number
rule.segmented_typing: Stop-start typing, as if being told what to type
rule.remote_app_recent: A remote-access app was installed this week
rule.repeated_new_payee_payments: Several payments to new people today
rule.high_new_payee_volume: Large total sent to new people today
rule.savings_liquidated: FD broken or loan taken this week
rule.guided_by_unknown_caller: Someone unknown on the phone is guiding the payment
rule.guided_by_known_contact: A saved contact is guiding the payment
rule.unknown_call_and_new_payee: New payee while on a call with an unknown number
rule.new_payee_large_amount: New payee and a much larger amount than usual
rule.large_share_of_balance: A large part of your balance
rule.contradiction_guidance: Said no one is guiding, but the phone shows a long unknown call or screen sharing
rule.contradiction_know_payee: Said they know the payee, but it is a first payment to a pasted UPI ID
contradiction.guidance: You said no one is guiding you, but your phone shows a long call with an unknown number or screen sharing. If someone is telling you what to do, it is okay to stop and hang up.
contradiction.know_payee: You said you know this person, but this is your first payment to them, they are not in your contacts and the UPI ID was pasted. Please check it is really them.
split.near_limit_split: Several payments just under a round limit in a short time
split.rapid_repeat: Several payments to this payee in a short time
split.escalation: Rising amounts to this payee today
deviation.largest: Larger than any payment in your history
note.gate: A new payee or a large amount was noted, but with no signs of pressure it is not treated as a scam sign on its own.
note.trust_applied: Trusted payee or planned payment: one level lower.
note.trust_blocked: Trusted payee or planned payment was NOT applied because of a serious warning sign.
note.split: Several payments in a short time were found.
feat.new_payee_txns_24h: Payments to new people in 24 h
feat.amount_sent_new_payees_24h: Sent to new people in 24 h
feat.ans_know_payee: Answer: do you know this person
